## Changes

Describe the app or update. Explain permissions added/removed, dependency/source
host changes, privacy changes and maintainer/ownership changes explicitly.

- [ ] I am an authorised maintainer, or this is the initial app submission.
- [ ] I changed only this app's directory and included pinned public inputs.
- [ ] Listing, AppStream, icon, screenshots/captions and privacy information are current.
- [ ] I have permission to redistribute the submitted app and assets.
- [ ] I understand that merge/metadata checks do not publish the app; build,
      runtime review and private signed release promotion are still required.

### Reviewer only

- [ ] Ownership/licensing and maintainer authority verified.
- [ ] Metadata, screenshots and permission/source diff reviewed.
- [ ] Exact HEAD approved for isolated build.
- [ ] Build/install/launch results and output commit recorded.
- [ ] Published signed release verified and linked (after promotion).
